cases.target_rule: an async block is a lazy Future value
cases.intended_cause: The async block has a concrete anonymous Future type whose output is usize.
cases.principled_repair: Keep asynchronous work represented as a Future until an executor or caller polls it.
cases.weak_repair: Execute hidden synchronous work before constructing the future.

cases.target_rule: Future::poll receives a pinned mutable receiver
cases.intended_cause: The custom future implements the required Pin<&mut Self> polling contract.
cases.principled_repair: Model poll as a state-machine transition through a pinned receiver.
cases.weak_repair: Add unsafe pointer access even though the state is Unpin and safely mutable.

cases.target_rule: pinned shared projection does not move the pointee
cases.intended_cause: Pin<&T>::get_ref exposes shared observation without granting movement.
cases.principled_repair: Project only the access needed and preserve the pinning contract.
cases.weak_repair: Recover an unrestricted mutable reference through unsafe code.

cases.target_rule: a pending future may clone the current Waker
cases.intended_cause: The future stores a cloned Waker rather than a reference tied to the current Context.
cases.principled_repair: Store or replace a cloned Waker and arrange a later wake when readiness changes.
cases.weak_repair: Busy-poll the future until the external event happens.

cases.target_rule: a 'static future may not borrow a stack local
cases.intended_cause: The async block borrows text, so its generated future cannot satisfy the required static lifetime.
cases.principled_repair: Move owned state into the async block or keep the future inside a scope that owns the borrow.
cases.weak_repair: Leak the string solely to manufacture a static reference.

cases.target_rule: a future is Send only when state held across suspension is Send
cases.intended_cause: Rc is retained across an await point, making the generated future non-Send.
cases.principled_repair: Use thread-safe ownership such as Arc when cross-thread execution is required, or avoid the Send requirement on a local executor.
cases.weak_repair: Add unsafe impl Send to Rc-like state.

cases.target_rule: Pin prevents moving a !Unpin pointee through safe dereferencing
cases.intended_cause: Dereferencing Pin<Box<Fixed>> does not permit moving the address-sensitive value out.
cases.principled_repair: Keep the value pinned and expose operations through pinned receivers.
cases.weak_repair: Use ptr::read to move the value while pretending the pinning guarantee remains valid.

cases.target_rule: Future::poll has the exact receiver Pin<&mut Self>
cases.intended_cause: The implementation uses &mut self and therefore does not match the Future trait method signature.
cases.principled_repair: Implement the exact pinned receiver and project state safely.
cases.weak_repair: Define an unrelated inherent poll method and assume executors will call it.

cases.target_rule: owned async task state can satisfy Send + 'static
cases.intended_cause: The async move block owns a Send String and returns a Send usize.
cases.principled_repair: Move task-owned state into the spawned future and retain its JoinHandle at the owning scope.
cases.weak_repair: Clone all task inputs without deciding which owner is authoritative.

cases.target_rule: spawned task output must satisfy the join boundary
cases.intended_cause: Both the future and its String output satisfy Send and static ownership.
cases.principled_repair: State task and output bounds explicitly at the spawning boundary.
cases.weak_repair: Erase the output into a global side effect to avoid modeling join results.

cases.target_rule: Arc supports shared task liveness when the inner type is thread-safe
cases.intended_cause: The worker receives a cloned Arc while the parent retains its own strong owner.
cases.principled_repair: Use Arc only when both task and parent require shared liveness.
cases.weak_repair: Put every task input behind Arc even when ownership could simply move.

cases.target_rule: a task nursery can centralize the spawn contract
cases.intended_cause: The method records the same ownership requirements a runtime spawn operation would impose.
cases.principled_repair: Make one owner responsible for spawning, joining, and classifying all child tasks.
cases.weak_repair: Return bare task handles to unrelated layers and hope they are joined.

cases.target_rule: ordinary spawned tasks cannot borrow a parent stack frame
cases.intended_cause: The future captures text by reference and may outlive the stack frame required by the spawn contract.
cases.principled_repair: Move owned task state into the future or use a structured scoped mechanism with bounded lifetime.
cases.weak_repair: Convert every borrowed input to a leaked static allocation.

cases.target_rule: task state sent to a multithreaded runtime must be Send
cases.intended_cause: The future retains Rc across suspension and cannot cross runtime worker threads safely.
cases.principled_repair: Use Arc for shared cross-thread state or a local-task facility with an explicit local execution model.
cases.weak_repair: Mark the generated future Send with unsafe code.

cases.target_rule: a joinable task output must be Send across the join boundary
cases.intended_cause: Although the future itself owns no non-Send state across suspension, its Rc output violates the output bound.
cases.principled_repair: Return a Send result or keep the entire task and result on a local executor.
cases.weak_repair: Discard the result and communicate through hidden shared state.

cases.target_rule: async move transfers captured ownership into the task
cases.intended_cause: token moves into the generated future and is unavailable to the parent afterward.
cases.principled_repair: Decide whether the task or parent owns the value; clone only when two independent values are required.
cases.weak_repair: Remove move and create an invalid non-static borrow.

cases.target_rule: fixed-width decoding must prove the exact byte range
cases.intended_cause: get and try_into establish that exactly four bytes exist before integer conversion.
cases.principled_repair: Validate the range before conversion and preserve a structured truncation path.
cases.weak_repair: Index directly and rely on panic for malformed network input.

cases.target_rule: a frame boundary can be represented as disjoint borrowed slices
cases.intended_cause: split_at preserves order and creates two non-overlapping views after the length check.
cases.principled_repair: Carry the validated boundary in slices or a cursor state.
cases.weak_repair: Copy both regions into new vectors after every read.

cases.target_rule: mem::take can transfer an owned buffer while leaving a valid empty value
cases.intended_cause: The mutable reference remains valid because the vector is replaced before ownership is returned.
cases.principled_repair: Use explicit ownership transfer at frame-completion boundaries.
cases.weak_repair: Clone the completed frame and retain stale bytes in the pending buffer.

cases.target_rule: a borrowed frame cannot outlive its receive buffer
cases.intended_cause: The returned Frame lifetime is tied to the input slice by elision.
cases.principled_repair: Keep borrowed decoded views within the buffer owner’s lifetime or produce an owned frame.
cases.weak_repair: Annotate the frame as static without owning the bytes.

cases.target_rule: fixed-size byte arrays of different lengths are distinct types
cases.intended_cause: A three-byte array cannot satisfy a four-byte frame-header contract.
cases.principled_repair: Validate and convert an exact four-byte slice before decoding.
cases.weak_repair: Pad malformed input silently with zero bytes.

cases.target_rule: buffer mutation may invalidate outstanding borrowed slices
cases.intended_cause: header keeps an immutable borrow live while push requires mutable access and may reallocate.
cases.principled_repair: Finish using borrowed views before mutating, or store offsets and reborrow afterward.
cases.weak_repair: Use raw pointers to keep the old slice across possible reallocation.

cases.target_rule: an owned receive buffer cannot move while a view into it remains live
cases.intended_cause: view borrows buffer and is used after the attempted ownership transfer.
cases.principled_repair: End the borrow before moving the buffer, or transfer an owned decoded value instead.
cases.weak_repair: Clone the entire buffer on every parser boundary.

cases.target_rule: a decoder may not return a slice into a local temporary buffer
cases.intended_cause: The local vector is dropped at function return, leaving the proposed slice dangling.
cases.principled_repair: Return an owned buffer or borrow from an input supplied by the caller.
cases.weak_repair: Leak each received frame to fabricate a long-lived slice.

cases.target_rule: a resolved socket address is an owned transport endpoint value
cases.intended_cause: SocketAddr owns its IP address and port independently of the source string.
cases.principled_repair: Resolve names at a deliberate boundary and pass owned endpoint values into connection code.
cases.weak_repair: Carry borrowed textual addresses through every connection layer.

cases.target_rule: program identity and argument boundaries should remain separate owned values
cases.intended_cause: The model preserves each argument without invoking a shell or flattening tokens.
cases.principled_repair: Represent executable and argument vector separately at the process boundary.
cases.weak_repair: Concatenate a command line string and let a shell reinterpret it.

cases.target_rule: a UDP socket is an owned operating-system resource
cases.intended_cause: The function signature makes ownership transfer explicit without claiming stream semantics.
cases.principled_repair: State which component owns each socket and when it closes.
cases.weak_repair: Treat a socket handle as a freely copyable integer.

cases.target_rule: connection lifecycle states should be matched exhaustively
cases.intended_cause: Every state is named and the terminal predicate covers the complete lifecycle.
cases.principled_repair: Model connection transitions explicitly and reject operations invalid for the current state.
cases.weak_repair: Use unrelated booleans whose combinations permit contradictory states.

cases.target_rule: a returned endpoint reference must be backed by caller-owned storage
cases.intended_cause: address is local and is destroyed before the proposed reference could be used.
cases.principled_repair: Return SocketAddr by value or borrow an address supplied by the caller.
cases.weak_repair: Store the endpoint in a mutable global.

cases.target_rule: moving resolver input into a closure transfers ownership
cases.intended_cause: host belongs to the closure after the move capture and cannot also be used by the caller.
cases.principled_repair: Choose one owner or clone only when independent ownership is part of the design.
cases.weak_repair: Use a raw pointer to share the string without a lifetime model.

cases.target_rule: connection lifecycle matches must handle every state
cases.intended_cause: Connecting and Closing are omitted from the match.
cases.principled_repair: Handle all states explicitly or use a deliberate catch-all only when their behavior is truly identical.
cases.weak_repair: Delete intermediate states from the model to satisfy the match.

cases.target_rule: TcpStream does not implement ordinary Clone ownership semantics
cases.intended_cause: The stream exposes try_clone because duplicating an OS handle is fallible and semantically significant.
cases.principled_repair: Use try_clone only when duplicated handle ownership is intentional and handle its error.
cases.weak_repair: Wrap every stream in Arc without deciding whether concurrent access is safe.

cases.target_rule: protocol authorization follows explicit session state
cases.intended_cause: The operation predicate is exhaustive and cannot accept work before negotiation.
cases.principled_repair: Represent protocol phases as an enum and centralize transition rules.
cases.weak_repair: Scatter boolean flags across handlers.

cases.target_rule: newtypes prevent accidental identifier interchange
cases.intended_cause: Request and connection identifiers share representation but remain distinct semantic types.
cases.principled_repair: Use local newtypes at protocol boundaries.
cases.weak_repair: Use bare integers everywhere and rely on variable names.

cases.target_rule: protocol parsing separates accepted syntax from rejection
cases.intended_cause: The parser returns a typed command or a causal error without mutating session state.
cases.principled_repair: Parse into a typed message before applying transitions.
cases.weak_repair: Mutate session state while still discovering whether syntax is valid.

cases.target_rule: a decoded message may transfer owned payload into command handling
cases.intended_cause: Pattern matching moves the owned body exactly once into the handling branch.
cases.principled_repair: Make message ownership and post-parse transfer explicit.
cases.weak_repair: Retain borrowed slices into a receive buffer after the buffer is reused.

cases.target_rule: protocol-state matches must cover terminal and closing states
cases.intended_cause: The Closing state is omitted, so the compiler rejects the incomplete transition view.
cases.principled_repair: Handle each protocol state and make closure behavior explicit.
cases.weak_repair: Remove the Closing state and conflate it with Ready.

cases.target_rule: semantic identifier newtypes are not interchangeable
cases.intended_cause: ConnectionId cannot be passed where a RequestId is required despite identical fields.
cases.principled_repair: Convert only through an explicit validated mapping when the protocol defines one.
cases.weak_repair: Replace both newtypes with u64.

cases.target_rule: message consumption transfers payload ownership
cases.intended_cause: message moves into consume and cannot be inspected afterward.
cases.principled_repair: Extract or borrow the data before consumption when the caller legitimately needs it.
cases.weak_repair: Clone every message before dispatch.

cases.target_rule: a parsed view may not outlive its source buffer
cases.intended_cause: The local String is destroyed at function return.
cases.principled_repair: Borrow from caller-owned input or return an owned parsed value.
cases.weak_repair: Leak every protocol line.

cases.target_rule: bounded resources should reject zero or invalid capacity at construction
cases.intended_cause: The newtype prevents downstream code from receiving an unvalidated zero capacity.
cases.principled_repair: Validate capacity once and pass the constrained type through admission code.
cases.weak_repair: Check for zero independently at every queue operation.

cases.target_rule: bounded channels transfer ownership and expose finite capacity
cases.intended_cause: The String has one queue owner between send and receive.
cases.principled_repair: Choose queue capacity as a documented product bound.
cases.weak_repair: Use an unbounded queue and call it backpressure.

cases.target_rule: broker admission depends on both queued work and active capacity
cases.intended_cause: The model keeps pending and active bounds explicit in one authority.
cases.principled_repair: Centralize admission in one broker state machine.
cases.weak_repair: Let every connection inspect and mutate separate counters.

cases.target_rule: multiple producers may share a bounded sender endpoint
cases.intended_cause: Cloning the sender adds a producer but does not duplicate queued values.
cases.principled_repair: Count producer liveness and define closure when all senders are dropped.
cases.weak_repair: Treat receiver closure as an application success condition in every context.

cases.target_rule: queue submission transfers ownership of the job
cases.intended_cause: job moves into send and is unavailable to the producer afterward.
cases.principled_repair: Retain a separate identifier or clone only the exact data that must remain local.
cases.weak_repair: Clone the entire job graph before every submission.

cases.target_rule: the standard mpsc Receiver is not Sync for concurrent shared receives
cases.intended_cause: A shared Receiver cannot be consumed concurrently without an ownership or synchronization strategy.
cases.principled_repair: Give one broker task sole ownership of the receiver or protect a deliberately shared queue.
cases.weak_repair: Add unsafe Sync to a wrapper without proving receive semantics.

cases.target_rule: overlapping mutable queue borrows require proven disjointness
cases.intended_cause: The first mutable borrow remains live when back_mut requests another mutable borrow.
cases.principled_repair: Use a method that proves disjoint indices or sequence the mutations.
cases.weak_repair: Create two raw pointers into the queue without accounting for aliasing.

cases.target_rule: a callback that consumes captured state is FnOnce, not FnMut
cases.intended_cause: Dropping value moves it out of the closure environment on the first call.
cases.principled_repair: Require FnOnce for one admission attempt or redesign the closure to borrow/recreate per call.
cases.weak_repair: Wrap the value in an Option and silently ignore the second call.

cases.target_rule: cooperative cancellation may share one monotonic signal
cases.intended_cause: The cloned token shares liveness and uses Release/Acquire publication for the flag.
cases.principled_repair: Define where cancellation is requested and where tasks observe it.
cases.weak_repair: Assume dropping an arbitrary handle automatically rolls back completed effects.

cases.target_rule: deadline and cancellation are distinct terminal outcomes
cases.intended_cause: The type prevents timeout from being confused with successful completion or explicit cancellation.
cases.principled_repair: Carry separate terminal variants through task and protocol layers.
cases.weak_repair: Collapse every interrupted operation into one string error.

cases.target_rule: Drop can encode local cleanup on every scope exit
cases.intended_cause: The guard owns the obligation to mark completion when its scope ends.
cases.principled_repair: Use a guard only for an invariant that remains valid during normal return and unwinding.
cases.weak_repair: Rely on a final line of cleanup that early returns can bypass.

cases.target_rule: graceful shutdown should be represented as ordered phases
cases.intended_cause: The state type makes admission policy explicit instead of using an ambiguous boolean.
cases.principled_repair: Name quiesce, drain, and stop transitions and assign one owner.
cases.weak_repair: Use one flag and infer every phase from timing.

cases.target_rule: an async move future owns its cancellation state
cases.intended_cause: token moves into the future and cannot also remain in the parent.
cases.principled_repair: Clone a shareable cancellation handle when both parent and child need authority.
cases.weak_repair: Remove move and later require an impossible static task lifetime.

cases.target_rule: a detached timeout future cannot borrow a parent local
cases.intended_cause: The async block captures deadline by reference and fails the static task contract.
cases.principled_repair: Move owned deadline data into the task or keep the future structurally scoped.
cases.weak_repair: Store deadlines in a mutable global.

cases.target_rule: cancellation by drop does not permit moving a pinned operation first
cases.intended_cause: The !Unpin operation cannot be moved out of its Pin<Box<_>>.
cases.principled_repair: Drop the pinned owner in place and make cancellation cleanup part of its state machine.
cases.weak_repair: Use ptr::read and abandon the original pinned storage.

cases.target_rule: two live futures cannot hold overlapping mutable borrows
cases.intended_cause: Each async block captures a mutable borrow of state for its entire future lifetime.
cases.principled_repair: Sequence the futures, partition the state, or put mutation behind one explicit owner.
cases.weak_repair: Convert state to a raw mutable pointer.

cases.target_rule: an HTTP-style handler may own its request body and return a typed response body
cases.intended_cause: The future owns the String and the response body type is explicit.
cases.principled_repair: Choose body ownership and response representation at the service boundary.
cases.weak_repair: Borrow body bytes from a connection buffer after the request future returns.

cases.target_rule: routing combines method and path into one explicit decision
cases.intended_cause: The match makes supported and fallback behavior visible.
cases.principled_repair: Keep routing deterministic and map every rejected surface to a deliberate status.
cases.weak_repair: Hide routing inside stringly middleware state.

cases.target_rule: a handler future with owned Send state may cross runtime workers
cases.intended_cause: The future’s captured and output state are thread-safe owned values.
cases.principled_repair: State Send requirements at the server spawning boundary.
cases.weak_repair: Assume every async handler is Send regardless of captured state.

cases.target_rule: request body ownership can move through a generic service boundary
cases.intended_cause: The body type remains explicit and is consumed exactly once.
cases.principled_repair: Stream or aggregate bodies under an explicit size policy.
cases.weak_repair: Duplicate the body for every middleware layer.

cases.target_rule: response body type must match the service signature
cases.intended_cause: Vec<u8> cannot initialize a Response<String>.
cases.principled_repair: Choose one response-body abstraction and convert deliberately at the boundary.
cases.weak_repair: Erase every body behind an unconstrained dynamic type.

cases.target_rule: a spawned HTTP connection future must not retain non-Send state
cases.intended_cause: Rc remains part of the future state across suspension.
cases.principled_repair: Use Arc for thread-safe shared application state or a deliberately local runtime.
cases.weak_repair: Declare the handler Send through unsafe code.

cases.target_rule: routing logic must remain exhaustive when the method model grows
cases.intended_cause: Delete is not handled.
cases.principled_repair: Define explicit behavior for every method or a justified fallback.
cases.weak_repair: Remove the method from the domain model while requests can still contain it.

cases.target_rule: a response or request view cannot outlive its owned body storage
cases.intended_cause: The local String is dropped when invalid returns.
cases.principled_repair: Return an owned body or borrow input owned by the caller.
cases.weak_repair: Leak every HTTP body.

cases.target_rule: retries may reuse one semantic idempotency key across transport attempts
cases.intended_cause: Each transport attempt receives an owned copy of the same logical key.
cases.principled_repair: Generate the semantic key once and reuse it unchanged for all retries.
cases.weak_repair: Generate a new key on every timeout.

cases.target_rule: a retry operation may require mutable per-attempt state
cases.intended_cause: FnMut accurately represents repeated invocation with evolving local state.
cases.principled_repair: Keep retry count and schedule explicit and bound the total attempts.
cases.weak_repair: Use unbounded recursion until the remote side responds.

cases.target_rule: network outcomes should distinguish rejection from ambiguous completion
cases.intended_cause: The type does not equate a lost response with a failed operation.
cases.principled_repair: Represent ambiguity explicitly and resolve it through idempotency or status lookup.
cases.weak_repair: Treat every timeout as proof that the server did nothing.

cases.target_rule: a deterministic bounded retry schedule can be tested as data
cases.intended_cause: The schedule is finite, ordered, and independent of wall-clock sleeping.
cases.principled_repair: Inject sleep and time so tests can observe scheduling decisions deterministically.
cases.weak_repair: Use real multi-second sleeps in unit tests.

cases.target_rule: owned retry inputs move into the first attempt
cases.intended_cause: key is consumed and cannot be reused for the second attempt.
cases.principled_repair: Borrow the key or clone the same semantic value for each owned attempt.
cases.weak_repair: Generate a different key for the second attempt.

cases.target_rule: retry callbacks must be callable for every permitted attempt
cases.intended_cause: The closure consumes request and therefore implements only FnOnce.
cases.principled_repair: Construct per-attempt owned requests from stable retry state or require FnOnce for a single attempt.
cases.weak_repair: Hide the request in Option and silently skip later retries.

cases.target_rule: detached retry tasks cannot borrow a stack-owned schedule
cases.intended_cause: The async block borrows schedule and fails the static ownership contract.
cases.principled_repair: Move owned schedule data into the task or keep retries in the caller’s structured scope.
cases.weak_repair: Promote test data to a mutable global.

cases.target_rule: retry state retained across await must satisfy the execution Send contract
cases.intended_cause: Rc makes the future non-Send.
cases.principled_repair: Use owned Send data or Arc when retry state must be shared across worker threads.
cases.weak_repair: Unsafely mark the retry state Send.

cases.target_rule: service resource limits should be validated before startup
cases.intended_cause: The validated configuration becomes owned startup state rather than repeated ad hoc checks.
cases.principled_repair: Reject invalid bounds at construction and pass one authoritative configuration.
cases.weak_repair: Substitute arbitrary defaults silently when operators provide zero.

cases.target_rule: advisory metrics may use relaxed atomics when they do not publish other state
cases.intended_cause: The counter itself is the only observed fact and does not guard protocol data.
cases.principled_repair: Classify metrics as advisory or authoritative before choosing synchronization.
cases.weak_repair: Use a relaxed flag to publish non-atomic service state.

cases.target_rule: integrated service lifecycle should make admission policy explicit
cases.intended_cause: The complete lifecycle is exhaustively classified.
cases.principled_repair: Give one supervisor authority over lifecycle transitions.
cases.weak_repair: Infer lifecycle from whether a listener currently returns errors.

cases.target_rule: service components can expose explicit boundaries without erasing their failures
cases.intended_cause: The trait ties each component to its own error family and stable identity.
cases.principled_repair: Use narrow component contracts at supervision boundaries.
cases.weak_repair: Convert every component failure to an unstructured string immediately.

cases.target_rule: a top-level service task must own long-lived configuration
cases.intended_cause: The future borrows a stack local but is required to be static.
cases.principled_repair: Move validated owned configuration into the supervisor future.
cases.weak_repair: Leak the configuration to satisfy the bound.

cases.target_rule: multithreaded service tasks may not retain Rc across suspension
cases.intended_cause: The generated future is non-Send because Rc is part of its suspended state.
cases.principled_repair: Use Arc for shared thread-safe service state or deliberately constrain execution to a local runtime.
cases.weak_repair: Add an unsafe Send implementation to the registry wrapper.

cases.target_rule: service audit logic must cover shutdown transition states
cases.intended_cause: Quiescing and Draining are omitted.
cases.principled_repair: Handle every lifecycle phase and its product behavior explicitly.
cases.weak_repair: Delete the intermediate phases while the implementation still uses them.

cases.target_rule: integrated mutable state cannot be mutably borrowed through overlapping paths
cases.intended_cause: The field borrow remains live when the entire structure is mutably borrowed.
cases.principled_repair: End the field borrow before borrowing the whole state or split disjoint operations.
cases.weak_repair: Use raw pointers to bypass the ownership proof.
